description: Shared Renovate preset of thomas-lg (github>thomas-lg/renovate-config). Repositories extend it and add their managers, groups, ignores and auto-merge policy.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes found in the OSV database (no GitHub setting needed): one PR per advisory, opened at once instead of waiting for Monday, labelled security, never merged without review.

packageRules.description: Every action bump edits the same few workflow files: one PR for minor and patch, one for majors, so they do not conflict with each other.

config:recommended types non-production dependencies as chore (:semanticPrefixFixDepsChoreOthers); every update is a dependency bump, so keep the deps prefix the PR title checks, labels and release notes expect. Kept last so it wins over the preset rules.
